sentences.text:
Ankit Alias Shubham And Another ... vs State Of Uttarakhand
And Others on 2 June, 2025

Author: Vivek Bharti Sharma
Bench: Vivek Bharti Sharma
 2025:Uhc:4406
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Criminal Misc Application No. 837 of 2024
Ankit Alias Shubham and Another .......Petitioners
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand and Others ......Respondents
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Shariq Khurshid, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Pratiroop Pande, learned A.G.A for the State.

Mr. Prince Chauhan, learned counsel for respondent nos.2 & 3.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
 Dated : 02.06.2025 Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.

This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused for quashing of the impugned charge sheet,
cognizance/summoning order dated 11.02.2020 passed in Criminal Case No. 74 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Judicial Magistrate, Jashpur, District Udham Singh Nagar as well as the entire proceedings of the above case qua the petitioner in view of the compromise arrived at between the parties.

2. In view of the fact that a Compounding Application (IA 1 of 2024) was filed by the parties, this Court, vide order dated 01.05.2025, had directed the parties to appear before the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh Nagar in order to 2025:UHC:4406 get their statements recorded and to verify the compromise deed.

3. Pursuant to such order, Member Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, District Udham Singh Nagar has submitted the report dated 14.05.2025 which clearly indicates that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and have also verified the contents of the compromise deed.
4. In view of the above, Compounding Application (IA No.2 of 2025) is hereby allowed.

As a consequence thereof, the cognizance/summoning charge sheet, cognizance/summoning order dated Ankit Alias Shubham And Another ... vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 2 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19006169/
1 11.02.2020 passed in Criminal Case No. 74 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Jashpur, District Udham Singh Nagar as well as the entire proceedings of the above case are hereby quashed qua the petitioner.
